source_workbook.context: Welcome to the Delaware SHIP Community Data Resource Guide! The State Health Improvement Plan (SHIP) team, comprised of University of Delaware and Delaware Division of Public Health, and KIDS COUNT in Delaware developed this resource to support community-based organizations (CBOs) in identifying relevant state data sets that can help enhance health and wellness within their communities. This resource provides background information, outlines key data categories and measures, and includes publication dates, data source timelines, links to the most current data, and access to archived reports. We welcome suggestions for additional resources. For questions, feedback, or recommendations, please contact Info@DelawareSHIP.org or visit our website at DelawareSHIP.org (Last Updated July 2026)
